resources.string: Watch progress, favorites, watchlist, and ratings ride Android Auto Backup to your Google Drive, so they return when you set up a new device. Backup follows your device\'s system setting — Edendale adds nothing of its own.
Connect your TMDB account to sync favorites, your watchlist, and ratings across devices. Watch time stays out of TMDB.
Double-tap the left or right side of the video to skip back or forward.
Touch and hold the left or right side of the video to play at that speed until you let go.
